# Kickoff (spec 02 §6): countdown when both sides are registered, restarted by roster changes.
config first_ball=home
next official

coin home 04000007 player=7
expect phase idle                    # both_sides: away is still empty
coin away 04000003 player=3
expect phase pregame
expect kickoff 5s
wait 3s
expect kickoff 2s
coin away 04000004 player=4          # a roster change restarts the countdown
expect kickoff 5s
button away                          # away has left: no kickoff
expect phase idle
expect kickoff none
coin away 04000003 player=3
expect phase pregame
wait 4s
expect phase pregame
wait 1s
expect phase playing                 # the game started by itself
expect started_by system
expect first_ball home
expect roster home=7,_ away=3,_     # 4 had left: not in the game
expect regs home=7,_ away=3,_

# Back to idle after the hold, since the game end ends the coin registrations.
plus home
plus home
plus home
plus home
plus home
expect phase finished
wait 10s
expect phase idle

# "Start now" during the countdown.
add home 7
add away 3
expect phase pregame
start official
expect phase playing
expect started_by table
expect kickoff none

# any_player, no delay: the first player starts a game at once.
config kickoff=any_player delay=0s first_ball=loser_previous
minus home                           # nothing to take back
expect error
plus away
plus away
plus away
plus away
plus away
expect winner away
wait 10s
add home 9
expect phase playing
expect first_ball home              # home lost the previous game
plus home
plus home
plus home
plus home
plus home
wait 10s

# alternate: the opposite of the previous game's first ball.
config first_ball=alternate delay=2s kickoff=both_sides
add home 7
add away 3
wait 2s
expect phase playing
expect first_ball away
